scene_meta.participants: Senareth, Vairis, Elyraen, Olythae, Nephoretti assembly, Torhh, transformed Pelagor (Giants)
scene_meta.focus: The Nephoretti endure their first night in physical form, debate shelter and territorial risk, recognize their bioluminescence as a vulnerability, and decide to attempt smaller contact approaches the next day.
scene_meta.continuity: Begins after sunset following the day 0 landing in chapter 002

scene_meta.location: Earth coastline landing beach / treeline boundary
scene_meta.participants: Senareth, Elyraen, Vairis, Kyreth, burnt-red Giant, transformed Pelagor (Giants)
scene_meta.focus: A small Nephoretti group approaches the treeline at first light, but a burnt-red Giant rumbles a warning and causes the forest Giants to retreat.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows the first night on the beach in scene 003.1

scene_meta.location: Earth coastline landing beach / treeline boundary
scene_meta.focus: Elyraen attempts a solo approach with submissive gestures, but is driven back by the burnt-red Giant's aggressive warnings.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows the failed group approach on day 2 in scene 003.2

scene_meta.location: Earth coastline landing beach / treeline boundary
scene_meta.focus: Olythae leaves stone pattern offerings near the treeline; the Giants leave them undisturbed through sunset.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows the solo approach on day 3 in scene 003.3

scene_meta.participants: Kyreth, Torhh (jade-green Giant), Senareth, Elyraen, Vairis, Nephoretti assembly
scene_meta.focus: Kyreth shapes water spirals in the shallows; Torhh approaches and responds with reciprocal water ripples, creating the first non-verbal breakthrough between Nephoretti and Giants.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows the art offering on day 4 in scene 003.4

scene_meta.participants: Kyreth, Torhh, copper-toned Giant, Olythae, Senareth, forest Giants
scene_meta.focus: Torhh returns at dawn to continue water-shaping dialogue with Kyreth, while a second copper-toned Giant joins to manipulate beach sand in response to Olythae's earlier art offering.
scene_meta.continuity: Follows the initial water breakthrough on day 5 in scene 003.5

scene_meta.participants: Senareth, Kyreth, Torhh, Olythae, copper-toned Giant, Elyraen, charcoal-grey Giant, Nephoretti assembly
scene_meta.focus: Five Giants engage in non-verbal dialogue with the Nephoretti; Senareth announces plans to introduce spoken sound patterns on day 8 to build the First Tongue.
